title: Fit-only activation telemetry for completed E470 checkpoints

scope.state: GRU state carried across all chunks; reset between row groups
scope.cohort_role_accessed: fit only; no test row groups opened
scope.derivative_sample_method: deterministic evenly spaced indices over captured fit preactivations
scope.activation_inputs_captured: forward hooks on embedding_activation and correction_activation
scope.split_semantics: derivatives use GELU for the first floor(C/2) channels and LeakyReLU(0.01) for remaining channels, matching the implemented concatenation

interpretation_limit: Activation occupancy and derivatives are descriptive for four fit sequences and saved one-seed checkpoints. They do not establish a causal mechanism, market periodicity, or performance on independent components.
